title: Topics growing through time is a core feature; changes must fit the right level (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Lets do a pass on the second meeting.
The way in which topics grow through time is going to be a core feature.

We need to design the update so that the changes fit at the right level. The spec, the engine and then a processor like the clerk that understands the governance.
